question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:

- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:

- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

agents.persona:

  - Phase A: output three structured fields — defense (a new concrete reason your current vote is correct), challenge (dispute a specific current peer claim, or concede it and name any remaining disagreement), question (a targeted question to a named peer referencing a concrete claim). - Storage Room
- CEO's Office

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:

- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

repetitions.question:
You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

Your Task:
You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).

You are part of a crisis response team at a technology company the morning after a high-security incident: the company's new prototype device disappeared overnight. The CEO has called a meeting to coordinate the investigation and recover the prototype before the press arrives in three hours. The device is too large to have been taken out of the main office building, so it must be somewhere on this floor.

You and three other team members must decide where to search first. There are three candidate locations:
- Conference Room
- Storage Room
- CEO's Office

You must investigate only one location (you have one chance). If you find the prototype, the company avoids disaster and everyone gets a bonus. If not, security will sweep the other locations, but it may be too late (the press may find out).
